gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 3 records and the existing base E.G.O dictionary. Rien follows enemy records 1347/1348. Spacing and spelling aliases are resolved by IDs. Same-named skills and the greatsword status retain form-specific official names. Shared HP, random weapon damage types, Prescript conditions, conditional Unbreakable conversion, and base E.G.O final-clash weakening are retained.

lead.text: Protect the Prescript's Target to deny fulfillment and build Karmic Consequence on the enemy. Assign the major skill to Ryōshū, and match physical types against the 3 Gloom skills later. Limit the Unbreakable hits that remain after Clash Wins.

statNote.text: Ryōshū is required; Gregor cannot deploy. Ryōshū starts at 45 SP and other Sinners at 30; Identities whose basic attacks all use negative Coins start at −25. The second half begins at 55% HP or less without a full heal. Both form tables refer to the same carried-over HP pool. The −5 Offense and Defense Levels from Rien's Mask and Sizzling Wound are shown separately.

skillNote.text: Actual damage types vary with the random weapon used for each Coin. The table's type is the skill classification; use it when matching attack types against second-half Gloom skills. The three first-half Pride skills have inconsistent Power ranges and Coin values, so Power is marked unconfirmed. Conditional Unbreakable conversion from Unlock and Prescript targeting is described in the text.

priorities.0.text: Early on, have Sinners other than the Prescript's target clash to disrupt Prescripts and build Karmic Consequence.

priorities.1.text: Have Ryōshū clash with Furioso skills; protect other allies with healing and advance debuffs.

priorities.2.text: In the second half, assign Sloth to Ryōshū and beat Gloom skills with matching Slash, Pierce, or Blunt attacks.

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Check for fully Unbreakable Coins against the Prescript's target and repeated Furioso hits. Assign major attacks to Ryōshū, who survives lethal damage while another ally lives; heal and apply debuffs in advance to protect the others.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Second-half Gloom skills overwhelm the team

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: During Indulgence in Prescripts, a clash loss against the same physical type or Ryōshū weakens them. Match Blunt with Blunt, Pierce with Pierce, and Slash with Slash. Assign the Sloth skill that only Ryōshū can clash with first.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The final Furioso clash is unwinnable

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Furioso[Lacrimosa-Crescendo] loses 20 Power when clashing with Ryōshū's base E.G.O. Save resources for Forest for the Flames. Keep other allies alive to maintain Ketsuen and Renketsuen's conditions.

phases.0.title.text: Bring Ryōshū and strong Slash, Pierce, and Blunt clashes

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Deploy seven Sinners including Ryōshū, with four backups. Gregor cannot deploy.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Prepare high-Power Slash, Pierce, and Blunt skills for the three second-half Gloom skills. Fill missing types with E.G.O. Save Ryōshū's Forest for the Flames for the final major attack.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Bring HP/SP recovery and ways to lower enemy Power. Chains of Others weakens enemies next turn, so use it before a major attack or Indulgence in Prescripts.

phases.0.steps.3.text: Ryōshū gains Gebura's Blade. Here it persists while another Sinner is alive, unlike its usual one-turn duration.

phases.1.title.text: Keep the Prescript's target out of clashes and make Prescripts fail

phases.1.steps.0.text: Check The Prescript's Target - The Index every turn. A Sinner other than Ryōshū is chosen and prioritized by Rien. Take over clashes with other Sinners to limit hits.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Device II succeeds through hits on its target or at least four hits in one turn. Do not protect only the designated target while leaving other attacks unopposed.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Failed Prescripts add Karmic Consequence, lowering Defense Level and Clash Power. Unlock also advances through HP and turn conditions, so its activation alone does not mean disruption failed.

phases.1.steps.3.text: At 75% HP or less, Unlock III and 9 Grace can activate, raising damage against everyone by 30% even in the first half. Avoid pushing HP too far before a major attack without healing and debuffs ready.

phases.2.timing.text: 9 Procuration · Major attacks from Turn 5 of the first half

phases.2.title.text: Have Ryōshū beat Furioso and prepare for remaining area damage

phases.2.steps.0.text: Uses Furioso at 9 Procuration [Hermes]. In the first half, missing stacks are filled to 9 on Turn 5 and every four turns afterward. Check the count and use Chains of Others or similar debuffs the turn before.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Furioso-Replica is an Unfocused Volley with Unbreakable Coins, often hitting the clasher repeatedly. Have Ryōshū win, using her survival against lethal damage while another ally lives.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Ryōshū surviving does not keep everyone safe. Check secondary targets' HP, Wrath resistance, and debuffs beforehand. The turn ends after the attack, so do not postpone healing.

phases.3.title.text: Keep the Prescript's target alive and manage Grace and Karmic Consequence

phases.3.steps.0.text: Removing the mask starts the second half with HP carried over. Procuration resets to 0 and Karmic Consequence becomes Karmic Consequence [Fortuna]. Do not simply extend the first half's counters.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Second-half Prescripts demand the target's death. Keeping them alive makes the Prescript fail, increasing Karmic Consequence and reducing Grace. At 9 Grace, damage against everyone rises by 50%; beware of damage immediately after the transition.

phases.3.steps.2.text: From the second-half transition, Indulgence in Prescripts occurs every two turns and missing Procuration is replenished every four. Check equipped skills to see whether the special pattern or major attack is active.

phases.3.steps.3.text: If using MOROSITAS from the Sapling of Light, consider stabilizing early second-half regular skills and Indulgence in Prescripts. Prepare healing and debuffs together.

phases.4.title.text: Ryōshū handles Sloth; beat the three Gloom skills with matching physical types

phases.4.steps.0.text: Only Ryōshū can clash with “Remember This, Sweetheart? Only You Can Clash Against This Move.” Assign her first.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Beat the three Gloom skills by matching Blunt with Blunt, Pierce with Pierce, and Slash with Slash. Ryōshū winning also meets the weakening condition, but check her available slots first.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Winning with the wrong type does not sufficiently reduce Unbreakable damage. Use strong E.G.O for missing types and check both win probability and remaining damage.

phases.4.steps.3.text: Ryōshū beating the Sloth skill adds Sizzling Wound. Beating all three Gloom skills adds more. Wounds also strengthen her base E.G.O's damage.

phases.5.title.text: Match Forest for the Flames against the final Furioso to finish

phases.5.steps.0.text: The final Furioso[Lacrimosa-Crescendo] loses 20 Power when clashing with Ryōshū's base E.G.O. Assign Forest for the Flames to weaken the remaining Unbreakable damage.

phases.5.steps.1.text: Renketsuen greatly increases base E.G.O damage according to the enemy's Sizzling Wound. Keep allies other than Ryōshū alive to maintain her protection from lethal damage.

phases.5.steps.2.text: Unopposed damage and damage from Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are greatly reduced. Clash while attacking and finish without allowing more enhanced major attacks.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Skill Power −2 and damage +20% against Index enemies. Rien prioritizes the target and makes every Coin of skills used against them Unbreakable.

mechanics.0.response.text: Generally take over clashes with another Sinner to protect the Prescript's target.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Maximum 9. Offense Level +1 per 3 stacks. At 9 Grace, damage against all targets increases by 30% in the first half and 50% in the second. In the second half, also grants Protection according to Grace.

mechanics.1.response.text: The same 9 Grace is more dangerous in the second form. Reduce it through failed Prescripts in the second half.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 100. At Turn Start, gain 1 Defense Level Down per 10, 1 Fragile per 20, and 1 Clash Power Down per 40 stacks.

mechanics.2.response.text: Build it by disrupting early Prescripts.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Maximum 200. At Turn Start, gain 1 Defense Level Down per 10, 1 Fragile per 20, and 1 Clash Power Down per 40 stacks. Second-half Protection also falls by 1 per 20 stacks.

mechanics.3.response.text: Keep the target alive in the second half too, building stacks to weaken major clashes.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Offense and Defense Levels −5. Take 5% more damage from skills that inflict Burn or Bleed, or 7.5% more from skills that inflict both.

mechanics.4.response.text: Status-inflicting skills can contribute damage, but unopposed attacks face a separate reduction.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Maximum 5. Offense and Defense Levels −5. Stacks increase Burn/Bleed Count and damage taken from skills that inflict them. Strengthens Ryōshū's Renketsuen.

mechanics.5.response.text: Resolve the special pattern correctly to add stacks and improve base E.G.O damage.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Inflicted Sinking Potency and Count +2. Makes every Coin of the special-pattern Gloom skills Unbreakable. Expires at Turn End and grants Karmic Consequence according to the number of skills that lost clashes.

mechanics.6.response.text: Win with matching physical types to weaken remaining damage too. Assign the Sloth skill to Ryōshū.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Increases through Attack Skill use; at 9 at Turn Start, uses a Furioso skill. After the major attack, per-skill gain tracking resets.

mechanics.7.response.text: Check current stacks and equipped skills as well as the cycle; apply debuffs the turn before.

mechanics.8.effect.text: First-half Ryōshū. Cannot fall below 1 HP while at least one other ally lives. Clash Power +1 and hit damage +10%. Clash wins generate three resources; prevents Stagger and removes Stagger Thresholds.

mechanics.8.response.text: Assign her major attacks, but keep other allies alive too.

mechanics.9.effect.text: Second-half Ryōshū. Retains HP protection while another ally lives, plus Clash Power +2 and hit damage +25%. Also gains buffs including +50% base E.G.O damage per enemy Wound stack (max 250%).

mechanics.9.response.text: Match Forest for the Flames against the final major skill and use Wound-based damage buffs.

mechanics.10.effect.text: Buffs include fully Unbreakable Coins and +100% damage. Basic attacks and Counters heal 10% of hit damage as HP (max 100 per skill). In 9-50, persists while a Sinner other than Ryōshū lives.

mechanics.10.response.text: Its duration differs from the usual Turn End expiry. Protect other allies.

mechanics.11.effect.text: Support gained at Combat Start by Sinners other than Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis.

mechanics.11.response.text: Distinguish it from Ryōshū's special effects and check which buffs are actually applied.

mechanics.12.effect.text: Offense and Defense Levels +1; heal 10 SP at Combat End. Prescripts and skill effects change with the stage.

mechanics.12.response.text: Do not expect SP reduction to last indefinitely; weaken through failed Prescripts.

mechanics.13.effect.text: Offense and Defense Levels +2; heal 20 SP at Combat End. Prescripts and skill effects change with the stage.

mechanics.13.response.text: Do not expect SP reduction to last indefinitely; weaken through failed Prescripts.

mechanics.14.effect.text: Offense and Defense Levels +3; heal 30 SP at Combat End. Prescripts and skill effects change with the stage.

mechanics.14.response.text: Do not expect SP reduction to last indefinitely; weaken through failed Prescripts.

mechanics.15.effect.text: A Prescript to hit the designated target by the first turn. Grace from completion caps at 3.

mechanics.15.response.text: Have a Sinner other than the target take over the clash.

mechanics.16.effect.text: A Prescript to hit the designated target by Turn 4, or land at least four attacks in one turn. Grace from completion caps at 6.

mechanics.16.response.text: Limit other hits as well as hits on the target.

mechanics.17.effect.text: A Prescript to use a powerful skill with nine weapon types. Grace from completion caps at 9.

mechanics.17.response.text: Check Procuration stacks and prepare for the major attack.

mechanics.18.effect.text: A Prescript to eliminate every obstacle before the next Prescript.

mechanics.19.effect.text: In the second half, prioritizes killing the Prescript's target.

mechanics.19.response.text: Keep the target alive to make the Prescript fail.

mechanics.20.effect.text: Gains Damage Up and Attack Power Up in proportion to lost HP. Poise Potency and Count gained through skills +1. SP difference with the target also increases damage.

mechanics.20.response.text: Enemy damage stays high in the final phase even with Karmic Consequence accumulated. Continue healing and debuffing.

warnings.0.text: Ryōshū's HP protection requires another living ally. Leaving only Ryōshū alive is not safe.

warnings.1.text: Gebura's Blade heals on basic attack and Counter hits. Forest for the Flames itself does not provide that same healing.

warnings.2.text: Coins become Unbreakable when attacks are aimed at the Prescript's target. Taking over the clash does not necessarily remove an already applied Unbreakable conversion.

warnings.3.text: Beat second-half Gloom skills with the same physical type or Ryōshū. Check the type even when the win prediction is favorable.

warnings.4.text: Rien's random weapons change actual incoming damage types. Slash resistance alone does not reduce every attack.

preparation.0.text: Prepare Ryōshū's Forest for the Flames, high-Power Slash/Pierce/Blunt clashes, and HP/SP recovery.

preparation.1.text: If bringing Meursault, use Chains of Others to weaken next turn's major attack or special pattern. Align the use turn with the effect turn.

preparation.2.text: Check Wrath resistance for Furioso skills too. If another E.G.O changes resistance, use it before the hit.

passives.0.effect.text:
At Turn Start:
- Gain a Prescript according to Unlock stage.
- Apply The Prescript's Target - The Index to a random Sinner other than Ryōshū and prioritize them.
- All Coins of skills used against the Prescript's target become Unbreakable.
· If the target dies or cannot be attacked, use remaining skills against a random Sinner other than Ryōshū, prioritizing the lowest current HP.
· If all other Sinners are dead, apply the target status to Ryōshū.

Damage against the Prescript's target +2.5% per Grace of the Prescript (max 20%).
- At 9 Grace, instead deal 30% more damage to all targets.
Do you wish for me to build a family?

“How did fate bring me a husband like you?”

passives.0.response.text: Have someone other than the Prescript's target take over clashes. In the second half, check the special pattern's types too.

passives.1.effect.text:
If the Prescript was completed this turn, at Turn End heal 10 SP and gain 3 Grace of the Prescript (once per turn).

If it was not completed, at Turn End gain 8 Karmic Consequence; its target gains 1 Clash Power Up next turn.
- Without Unlock, gain 1 Grace at Turn End.
- At 9 Grace, cannot gain Karmic Consequence.
Do you wish for me to lose a family?

“Honey, I'm heading north for a while.”
“Oh, a package is due this afternoon. Could you receive it for me, my beloved daughter?”

passives.1.response.text: Aim for Karmic Consequence in the first half, then more Karmic Consequence and less Grace in the second. Protect the target.

passives.2.effect.text:
Take 50% less damage from unopposed attacks.
Take 50% less damage from Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking.
When recovering SP through Unlock, if SP is below 0, restore it to 0.

At Stage Start, gain Rien's Mask.

At 55% HP or less, change phase:
- Remove all effects other than unique effects.
- Reset Procuration [Hermes] to 0.
“I waited for that time, just as the Prescript said. Even after my daughter left, I waited and waited.”

Then one day Limbus Company contacted me, and a back door opened. The device rang, and I knew it was time to bring my daughter home.

passives.2.response.text: Reduces unopposed damage and damage from Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking. Clash while attacking.

passives.3.effect.text:
Each Coin randomly chooses a weapon and applies its special effect:
- Hatchet: hacking through ribs.
- Stiletto: piercing lungs.
- Bastard sword: crushing shoulder and skull.
- Rapier: making at least ten holes in the body.
